hero.title: Better feed. More milk. A healthier herd.
hero.lead: Balanced cattle feed and supplements for cows and buffaloes, made to support milk yield, fat and everyday health.

collections.title: Feed for every stage of your herd

benefits.title: Nutrition that shows in the milk can

milk.title: Supports milk yield
milk.body: Energy and protein in the right balance help your animals keep up steady milk production.

fat.title: Better fat and SNF
fat.body: Quality ingredients support the fat and SNF your dairy pays for.

immunity.title: Everyday health
immunity.body: Added minerals and vitamins support immunity, digestion and a healthy coat.

fertility.title: Healthy fertility
fertility.body: Good nutrition supports regular heat cycles and healthy calving.

choose.title: Choose the right feed
choose.body: Pick a feed for your animal's stage: calf, heifer, milking or dry.

mix.title: Follow the pack guide
mix.body: Feed the amount on the pack alongside green and dry fodder, with clean water.

feed.title: Stay consistent
feed.body: Feed at the same times every day and change feeds slowly over a week.
